verdict.rationale: Adyen documents issuing a virtual card through the API by creating a paymentInstrument resource, though an account holder and balance account must be created first, so it is not a single call. Cardholders can see PAN, CVC and expiry through an in-app iOS SDK, which is not the same as the developer receiving them in the API response. Missing for 10: a one-call issuance flow, PAN/CVV/expiry returned programmatically at issuance (only a cardholder-facing reveal SDK is documented), and any evidence of self-serve sandbox-to-live activation without a sales cycle.
